input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-supplier or minimum-requirements obligation binds AP anywhere in the Agreement. To the contrary, the Kubient Services clause (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer Inventory through other agents or sell it to third parties, so AP retains full freedom to use other ad platforms. The remaining "exclusive" references are unrelated and non-restrictive: p0002 grants AP a non-exclusive licence (in our favour), p0064 is an exclusive jurisdiction/venue provision, p0065 concerns each Party's own trademarks, and p0072/p0073 are entire-agreement and no-third-party-beneficiary boilerplate. Searches for sole-source, requirements-purchase, non-compete and competitor-restriction language returned nothing. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer); no redline required.
